title: FAA issues rare nationwide ground stop
excerpt: The Federal Aviation Administration has ordered only the third nationwide ground stop in its history as it works to resolve technical troubles.
body_html:
The Federal Aviation Administration has implemented a rare nationwide ground stop, marking only the third time such an order has been issued in the agency's history. According to officials, the widespread halt may remain in place for a while as technical teams actively troubleshoot the ongoing issues.

Further details regarding the exact nature of the technical problems or the expected timeline for normal operations to resume have not yet been provided. Travelers are advised to check directly with their airlines for updates on flight statuses and potential delays.
